title: Eastern Tribes Return Home

questions.question: Who did Joshua summon and bless before sending them away?
options: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.correctAnswer: The Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:1 (ESV): "At that time Joshua summoned the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh..."

questions.question: What did these tribes build by the Jordan?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:10 (ESV): "...built an altar there by the Jordan, an altar of imposing size."

questions.question: How did the rest of Israel react to the building of the altar?
options: They gathered at Shiloh to make war against them
questions.correctAnswer: They gathered at Shiloh to make war against them
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:12 (ESV): "...the whole congregation of the people of Israel gathered at Shiloh to make war against them."

questions.question: Who was sent to investigate the altar?
options: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest and ten chiefs
questions.correctAnswer: Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest and ten chiefs
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:13-14 (ESV): "Then the people of Israel sent... Phinehas... and with him ten chiefs..."

questions.question: What was the true purpose of the altar?
options: To be a witness that they have a portion in the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: To be a witness that they have a portion in the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:27 (ESV): "but to be a witness between us and you... that we have a portion in the Lord."

questions.question: What past sin did Phinehas remind them of?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:17 (ESV): "Have we not had enough of the sin at Peor from which even yet we have not cleansed ourselves...?"

questions.question: What other instance of breach of faith is mentioned?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:20 (ESV): "Did not Achan the son of Zerah break faith in the matter of the devoted things...?"

questions.question: What did the eastern tribes name the altar?
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:34 (ESV): "The people of Reuben and the people of Gad called the altar Witness..."

questions.question: Where was the altar built specifically?
options: In the region of the Jordan on the side of Canaan (Geliloth)
questions.correctAnswer: In the region of the Jordan on the side of Canaan (Geliloth)
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:10 (ESV): "And when they came to the region of the Jordan that is in the land of Canaan..."

questions.question: Did the explanation satisfy Phinehas and the chiefs?
options: Yes, it was good in their eyes
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, it was good in their eyes
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:30 (ESV): "...it was good in their eyes."

questions.question: What phrase did the eastern tribes use to describe God?
options: The Mighty One, God, the Lord! (El Elohim Yahweh)
questions.correctAnswer: The Mighty One, God, the Lord! (El Elohim Yahweh)
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:22 (ESV): "The Mighty One, God, the Lord! The Mighty One, God, the Lord!"

questions.question: Why were they afraid their children would be stopped from worshiping?
options: Because the Jordan was a boundary between them
questions.correctAnswer: Because the Jordan was a boundary between them
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:25 (ESV): "For the Lord has made the Jordan a boundary between us and you..."

questions.question: What did Phinehas say proved that the Lord was in their midst?
options: Because you have not committed this breach of faith against the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Because you have not committed this breach of faith against the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:31 (ESV): "Today we know that the Lord is in our midst, because you have not committed this breach of faith..."

questions.question: The eastern tribes returned with what?
options: Much wealth, livestock, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and clothing
questions.correctAnswer: Much wealth, livestock, silver, gold, bronze, iron, and clothing
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:8 (ESV): "...Return to your tents with much wealth and with very much livestock..."

questions.question: Where did Phinehas depart to?
options: To the land of Canaan, to the people of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: To the land of Canaan, to the people of Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 22:32 (ESV): "...returned... to the land of Canaan, to the people of Israel..."

key_verse_text: The people of Reuben and the people of Gad called the altar Witness, “For,” they said, “it is a witness between us that the LORD is God.” (ESV)
